subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does the workflow/security owner approve these exact new third-party action revisions for workflows that receive GitHub App private keys and OpenAI API keys?
rationale: Only an owner can accept the supply-chain and credential-boundary risk of replacing pinned action commits; no mechanical patch can establish that trust decision.

options.title: Require owner approval and live evidence
options.body: Record approval of the exact upstream commits and add redacted after-update workflow evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept the revision risk explicitly
options.body: A workflow/security owner may merge based on the Dependabot update after documenting that the credential-bearing action revisions are accepted.

options.title: Pause the batch update
options.body: Close or defer this dependency batch if the required upstream action review cannot be completed promptly.

recommendation.title: Require owner approval and live evidence
recommendation.body: Record approval of the exact upstream commits and add redacted after-update workflow evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows recent direct attention to this PR, though file-history ownership could not be established from the available review material.
